verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev's own docs describe TypeScript/JavaScript (Node.js and Bun) as the core language, with Python support only 'via build extension' and no mention of Go or other languages at all — this is far from 'real feature parity' across multiple SDKs as the story requires. Missing for 10: native first-class Go SDK, native first-class Python SDK with parity (not a build-extension workaround), and any evidence of equivalent feature sets across languages.
